CustomField.description: Evaluates to number of days before opportunity close date based on response date whether or not the opportunity is closed. Same day is 0, after opportunity close is blank.
CustomField.formula: IF( Opportunity__r.CloseDate - DATEVALUE(Response_Date__c) >= 0, Opportunity__r.CloseDate - DATEVALUE(Response_Date__c), NULL)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Evaluates to number of days before opportunity close date based on response date whether or not the opportunity is closed. Same day is 0, after opportunity close is blank.
CustomField.label: Days Before Opportunity Close
